craft_notes: Sthāyin: śeṣavṛtti unit 27. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 9. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Goddess one or pure should speak or mate-natured; there mantra clear from mouth by Guru whispered proclaimed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: devīmekāmatho śuddhāṃ vadedvā yāmalātmikām tatra mantraṃ sphuṭaṃ vaktrādguruṇopāṃśu coditam
